text:
The ERC fails because `sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8` has no isolated well, so the NMOS bulks have to go to vss. Tying them to vss adds body effect: M1 and M2 sit at Vsb ≈ Veb, so the gate node vgn rises and M3 loses headroom, especially when cold. M1 and M2 see the same Vsb, so their Vgs still match. To recover headroom I'm raising NMOS gm/Id, shortening Ln, cutting I and raising PMOS gm/Id to lower Vdsat.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "ERC: nfet bulks must be vss. Tie M1/M2 bulk to vss and size with vsb=Veb so body effect is modelled. Matching survives because both see equal Vsb. Recover M3 headroom: higher gm/Id on both pairs, shorter Ln, lower branch current."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (3e-6, 1e-6, 8e-6),      # per-branch PTAT current
    "K":      (9.6, 7.5, 12.0),        # R2/R1
    "gmid_p": (13.0, 9.0, 16.0),       # PMOS mirror gm/Id (low Vdsat for headroom)
    "Lp":     (10.0, 4.0, 20.0),       # long L for low lambda -> line regulation
    "gmid_n": (22.0, 14.0, 26.0),      # NMOS pair in weak inversion, low Vgs
    "Ln":     (1.0, 0.5, 3.0),
    "If":     (1.5e-6, 0.5e-6, 5e-6),  # follower bias current
    "Cc":     (1e-12, 0.2e-12, 5e-12), # X-node compensation cap to vdd
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    N = 8
    I = p["I"]; K = p["K"]
    R1 = UT * math.log(N) / I
    R2 = K * R1

    veb1 = 0.735 + UT * math.log(I / 10e-6)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.4)
    vg = VDD - mp.vgs
    # NMOS pair, bulk at vss: both M1/M2 see Vsb ~= Veb -> equal body effect, matched Vgs
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.4, vsb=veb1)
    vgn = veb1 + mn.vgs
    mf = lut.size("n", 18.0, 1.0, p["If"], vds=VDD - vg, vsb=vg)
    Rf = vg / p["If"]
    vx = vg + mf.vgs

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    n.dev("M3", "ngate", "vg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "vg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "vg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M1", "ngate", "ngate", "ea", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "ngate", "sb", "vss", mn)
    n.R("R1", "sb", "eb", R1)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "ea", m=1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "eb", m=N)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    n.dev("MF", "vdd", "x", "vg", "vss", mf)
    n.R("RF", "vg", "vss", Rf)
    n.C("CC", "x", "vdd", p["Cc"])
    # Start-up
    n.M("MSP", "st", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MSN", "st", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MS1", "vg", "st", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 0.5)

    # Predictions
    ptat = K * UT * math.log(N)
    vref = veb1 + ptat
    dveb = (veb1 - 1.2) / 300.0 - 0.25e-3
    dptat = ptat / 300.15
    resid = abs(dveb + dptat)
    curv = 2.5e-3
    tc = (resid * 165 + curv) / vref / 165 * 1e6
    lam = mp.gds / mp.Id
    line = lam * (ptat + K / p["gmid_n"])
    itot = 3 * I + p["If"] + 0.6e-6
    power = VDD * itot
    m3_vds = VDD - vgn
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": line, "power": power,
               "startup_ok": 1, "psrr_1k": -db(line + 1e-4),
               "vx": vx, "vg": vg, "vgn": vgn, "m3_vds": m3_vds, "m2_vds": vx - veb1}
```
